title: Independent native retest of Dojo checkout and recovery fixes
scope: Rebuilt native Tauri QA/normal app checks, independent production-source review and focused tests. Real Dojo sandbox only; not live acquiring, physical-device, Windows or full Dojo go-live certification.

attribution.nativeAndLocalLedger: Directly observed/read by this independent retester.
attribution.portal: Exact current Dojo portal comparisons performed and reported by root in its authenticated browser session.
attribution.portalAccessLimit: The retester's browser partition could not access root's existing tab 5. No new portal tab was created and no portal mutation was performed.

independentAutomatedChecks.limits: Production availability helper/config store and extracted checkout guard/dispatch branches; provider and ledger callbacks mocked. Not native UI.
Production recovery orchestration with mocked native/provider boundaries, including five provider-overlap regressions. Not real provider UI.

final.testTerminalResult: Dojo terminal is online and available

limitations: No live acquiring, physical terminal, printer, cash payout, Windows, successful refund, nonzero extras or full feature certification.
No exact provider-overlap instrumentation in the native app; deterministic production-module tests cover that concurrency race.
Portal observations are root-owned; native/local verification is directly independent.
Native screenshots were shown through computer-use output; no saved screenshot file artifact is claimed.

The original normal mock trolley had to be cleared/recreated to enter settings; its one-item £6 shape was restored, all temporary held work removed, and two new sandbox receipts intentionally retained.
